issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Stock.add(String) with a void return type, but both the template and the solution implement Stock.add(String) returning an int. This mismatch between the specification and the provided code can confuse students about the expected method signature and return value and may lead to incorrect implementations or misunderstandings when they use Stock.add in SealSaloon logic.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and the code. Either update the problem statement UML and text to declare Stock.add(String): int (preferred, matching template and solution) or change the template and solution implementations of add to return void and adjust any code that relies on the returned quantity accordingly.
